description: Divergence class: MPP charge challenge-id HMAC derivation. base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, realm|method|intent|request|expires|digest|opaque)) with absent optionals joined as empty strings. Required-only inputs (no expires/digest/opaque). Mirrors rust compute_challenge_id (protocol/core/challenge.rs). Pins cross-SDK challenge-id agreement byte-for-byte so two SDKs computing a different id from the same inputs are caught here, not behind a live-server roundtrip.

spec.quote: Servers MUST bind the challenge id to realm, method, intent, and request, and to expires, digest, opaque, and header when present.

description: Challenge-id HMAC with an RFC 3339 expires segment. The expires string is an RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (battle-tested format) and must enter the HMAC input verbatim, changing the id relative to required-only.

spec.quote: Servers MUST bind the challenge id to realm, method, intent, and request, and to expires, digest, opaque, and header when present.

description: Challenge-id HMAC with a digest segment (RFC 9530 Repr-Digest SFV value sha-256=:...:). The digest binds the request body hash into the id; it must enter the HMAC input verbatim.

spec.quote: Servers MUST bind the challenge id to realm, method, intent, and request, and to expires, digest, opaque, and header when present.

description: Challenge-id HMAC with an opaque segment. opaque is server-issued nonce material; it must enter the HMAC input verbatim.

spec.quote: Servers MUST bind the challenge id to realm, method, intent, and request, and to expires, digest, opaque, and header when present.

description: Challenge-id HMAC with every optional present (expires + digest + opaque). Pins the fully-bound id so an SDK that drops or reorders any segment diverges here.

spec.quote: Servers MUST bind the challenge id to realm, method, intent, and request, and to expires, digest, opaque, and header when present.

description: Divergence class: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payment envelope wire bytes. The envelope object {x402Version, accepted, payload} is canonicalized via RFC 8785 JCS and base64url-encoded; the canonical accepted object carries scheme/network/amount/asset/payTo/maxTimeoutSeconds(=300 default). Pins the exact wire string so an SDK that quotes a parameter differently, reorders fields, or base64url-pads the embedded payload breaks here instead of silently passing the on-chain settlement oracle. (The optional `extra` map is omitted here: an empty `{}` is indistinguishable from `[]` once decoded into a dynamically-typed runner's untyped container, so the empty-map encoding is a separate concern from envelope wire agreement.)

spec.quote: All JSON {{RFC8259}} objects carried in auth-params or HTTP headers in this specification MUST be serialized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) {{RFC8785}} before encoding.

description: Divergence class: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge envelope wire bytes. The 402 challenge body {x402Version, accepts:[...], error} is canonicalized via RFC 8785 JCS and base64url-encoded. accepts carries the same canonical PaymentRequirements as the accepted echo. Pins the exact challenge-envelope wire string across SDKs. (The optional `extra` map is omitted, same rationale as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE vector.)

spec.quote: All JSON {{RFC8259}} objects carried in auth-params or HTTP headers in this specification MUST be serialized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) {{RFC8785}} before encoding.
